$comment: Machine-readable gasm ABI. Source of truth for spec/gasm.h and guests/gasm/src/sys.rs (scripts/gen-abi.mjs) and for runner conformance checks (scripts/gen-abi.mjs --check). Prose: spec/ABI.md.

ptr.doc: offset into guest memory; C/Rust pointer types given per parameter

exports.name: gasm_frame
exports.doc: One simulation + render step, called at the frame rate.

exports.name: gasm_run
exports.doc: The game's whole run with its own loop: runners with stack switching call it on the first frame instead of gasm_frame; each yield_frame ends a frame. Returning ends the game with that exit code.

exports.name: gasm_exit
exports.doc: The player is quitting: flush saves (best effort).

exports.name: _initialize
exports.doc: WASI reactor constructor hook, called first if present.

functions.name: log
functions.doc: Write a line to the runner's log.

functions.name: has
functions.doc: 1 if the runner provides an import module ("gasm:gfx") or a function in one ("gasm.asset_size64", "gasm:gfx.destroy"), else 0. Calling an import the runner lacks traps, so probe optional features first.

functions.name: time_ms
functions.doc: Monotonic time in milliseconds (virtual, frame-derived in headless runs).

functions.name: max_threads
functions.doc: How many worker threads this run lets the game start at once (wasi-threads: thread-spawn); 0 when it allows none (headless runs, browsers), so a game sizes its thread pool from it instead of failing to spawn.

functions.name: utc_offset_minutes
functions.doc: The player's time zone now: minutes east of UTC, daylight saving included (120 for CEST, -300 for EST). 0 in headless runs. Local time is the WASI realtime clock plus this offset.

functions.name: set_frame_rate
functions.doc: Rate (Hz) at which the runner calls gasm_frame(). Default 60; 1-1000.

functions.name: video_present
functions.doc: Present RGBA8 pixels (bytes R,G,B,A), stride bytes per row, w,h <= 4096. Copied before returning; letterboxed by the runner.

functions.name: video_set_aspect
functions.doc: Show video_present frames at display aspect num:den (4:3 for 320x200 DOS games) instead of square pixels; 0:0 resets. Both 1..65535 with 1/8 <= num/den <= 8, else traps. Display and the pointer frame position only (not hashed). Newer than has: probe has("gasm.video_set_aspect") first.

functions.name: audio_config
functions.doc: Format for audio_push: 8-192 kHz, 1 or 2 channels. Default 44100/2.

functions.name: audio_push
functions.doc: Queue frames x channels interleaved f32 samples in [-1, 1]; the runner resamples.

functions.name: input_pad
functions.doc: Bitmask of GASM_BTN_* held on virtual pad player (0..3), stable within a frame.

functions.name: text_input
functions.doc: UTF-8 text typed since the previous frame (backspace = \b, enter = \n), stable within a frame. Returns its length (copied only if length <= cap; cap = 0 queries), or -1 if the runner has no keyboard.

functions.name: input_mode
functions.doc: GASM_INPUT_* flags: KEYS_RAW (the runner stops mapping the keyboard to pads; gamepads still map), POINTER_HIDDEN (hide the system cursor over the game), POINTER_LOCKED (capture the pointer for relative motion; best effort, the browser needs a click).

functions.name: key_state
functions.doc: Held keys as a bitset indexed by GASM_KEY_* (bit k%8 of byte k/8), stable within a frame. Copies min(len, GASM_KEY_STATE_BYTES) bytes; returns GASM_KEY_STATE_BYTES, or -1 if the runner has no keyboard.

functions.name: key_events
functions.doc: Key presses and releases since the previous frame, in order: 4 bytes each (u16 GASM_KEY_* code, u8 1 = down / 0 = up, u8 0). Returns the byte length (copied only if <= cap; cap = 0 queries), or -1 if the runner has no keyboard.

functions.name: pointer
functions.doc: Mouse/touch state for this frame as GASM_POINTER_BYTES bytes (see ABI.md: position in drawable and frame pixels, relative motion, wheel, buttons held/pressed/released, flags). Copied only if cap is large enough; returns GASM_POINTER_BYTES, or -1 if the runner has no pointer.

functions.name: gamepad
functions.doc: Raw gamepad/joystick in slot 0-3 (connection order) as GASM_GAMEPAD_BYTES bytes: u32 flags (GASM_GAMEPAD_CONNECTED, GASM_GAMEPAD_STANDARD), u32 button count, u32 axis count, f32 buttons[32] (0-1), f32 axes[16] (-1..1). Standard mapping: W3C button and axis order. Copied only if cap is large enough; returns GASM_GAMEPAD_BYTES, or -1 if slot > 3 or the runner has no gamepad support.

functions.name: gamepad_name
functions.doc: Device name of the gamepad in slot: its length (copied only if <= cap), or -1 if the slot is empty.

functions.name: asset_size
functions.doc: Size in bytes of asset name, -1 if it does not exist, or -2 if it is 2 GiB or larger (use asset_size64).

functions.name: asset_size64
functions.doc: Size in bytes of asset name (any size), or -1 if it does not exist.

functions.name: asset_read
functions.doc: Copy up to cap bytes of asset name into dst. Bytes copied, or -1 if missing.

functions.name: asset_read_at
functions.doc: Copy up to len bytes of asset name starting at offset (streaming). Bytes copied (0 at the end), or -1 if missing.

functions.name: asset_read_at64
functions.doc: asset_read_at with a 64-bit offset, for assets of 4 GiB and more.

functions.name: asset_count
functions.doc: Number of assets.

functions.name: asset_name
functions.doc: Name of asset index (0 .. asset_count-1, sorted by UTF-8 bytes; folder entries as named on disk). Its length (copied only if length <= cap; cap = 0 queries), or -1 if index is out of range.

functions.name: asset_version
functions.doc: Version of asset name, -1 if it does not exist: 0 for assets given at launch, a new, larger number each time the embedder replaces it while the game runs (between frames). Poll it to notice new data; a read spanning frames should check it did not change.

functions.name: param
functions.doc: Launch parameter value length, or -1 if unset. Copied only if length <= cap (cap = 0 queries the length).

functions.name: set_title
functions.doc: Name the game's window or tab (the runner adds its own suffix). Control characters and bidi overrides are removed and the rest is cut to 256 bytes; empty resets to the default. Newer than has: probe has("gasm.set_title") first.

functions.name: yield_frame
functions.doc: End the frame inside gasm_run: the runner suspends the guest and resumes it at the start of the next frame. Traps outside gasm_run (and on runners without stack switching: probe has("gasm.yield_frame")).

modules.name: gasm:gfx
modules.doc: GPU rendering: a WebGPU subset. Handles are u32 (0 is never valid); creation descriptors are JSON mirroring WebGPU with color format "surface" and depth format "depth24plus". Invalid descriptors trap.

functions.name: width
functions.doc: Current drawable width in pixels.

functions.name: height
functions.doc: Current drawable height in pixels.

functions.name: create_shader
functions.doc: Compile WGSL source.

functions.name: create_buffer
functions.doc: size: non-zero multiple of 4; usage: GASM_BUF_* (WebGPU GPUBufferUsage bits; COPY_DST always added).

functions.name: create_pipeline
functions.doc: GPURenderPipelineDescriptor as JSON. layout: "auto" (default) or an array of bind group layout handles.

functions.name: create_bind_group
functions.doc: {"layout":L,"entries":[...]} or {"pipeline":P,"group":G,"entries":[...]}; entries {"binding":B,"buffer":H,"offset":O,"size":S}, {"binding":B,"texture":T} or {"binding":B,"sampler":S}.

functions.name: create_bind_group_layout
functions.doc: GPUBindGroupLayoutDescriptor subset: {"entries":[{"binding":B,"visibility":GASM_STAGE_*,"buffer":{"type":"uniform"|"read-only-storage","hasDynamicOffset":bool,"minBindingSize":N} | "texture":{"sampleType":"float"|"unfilterable-float","viewDimension":"2d"} | "sampler":{"type":"filtering"|"non-filtering"}}]}.

functions.name: create_texture
functions.doc: 2D texture: {"size":[w,h],"format":"rgba8unorm"|"rgba8unorm-srgb","mipLevelCount":n}, w,h 1-8192. Usage is TEXTURE_BINDING | COPY_DST.

functions.name: write_texture
functions.doc: Upload a tightly packed RGBA8 region (len = width*height*4) of mip level mip at (x, y). Queued like write_buffer.

functions.name: create_sampler
functions.doc: GPUSamplerDescriptor subset: addressModeU/V, magFilter, minFilter, mipmapFilter, lodMinClamp, lodMaxClamp, maxAnisotropy (1-16).

functions.name: write_buffer
functions.doc: Queue a write, applied before the frame's draws. offset/len: multiples of 4.

functions.name: begin_frame
functions.doc: Start the frame (clears color and depth). 1 = will be shown, 0 = discarded (the guest may skip draws).

functions.name: set_bind_group_offsets
functions.doc: set_bind_group with count dynamic offsets (multiples of 256), one per dynamic-offset entry of the layout, in binding order.

functions.name: set_viewport
functions.doc: Viewport in drawable pixels (clamped to the drawable), depth range 0-1. Reset to the whole drawable by begin_frame.

functions.name: set_scissor_rect
functions.doc: Scissor rectangle in drawable pixels (clamped to the drawable). Reset to the whole drawable by begin_frame.

functions.name: set_vertex_buffer
functions.doc: slot 0-7; buffer with GASM_BUF_VERTEX; offset a multiple of 4, at most the buffer size.

functions.name: set_index_buffer
functions.doc: buffer with GASM_BUF_INDEX; format GASM_INDEX_U16 or GASM_INDEX_U32 (anything else traps); offset a multiple of the index size, at most the buffer size.

functions.name: draw
functions.doc: Needs a pipeline, and a vertex buffer in every slot the pipeline reads, large enough for the vertices and instances drawn (else traps).

functions.name: draw_indexed
functions.doc: Like draw, plus an index buffer holding first_index + index_count indices.

functions.name: end_frame
functions.doc: Submit and present.

functions.name: destroy
functions.doc: Release an object of any kind. The handle becomes invalid (later use, including another destroy, traps) and is never reused; objects created from it stay valid. GPU memory is freed once nothing in a submitted frame uses it.

modules.name: gasm:gl
modules.doc: OpenGL ES 3.0 with WebGL 2's rules (design/gasm-gl.md): object names are u32 (0 = none), uniform locations i32 (-1 = none), data (ptr, len) in guest memory with checked lengths. GL errors are GL's (get_error, the call has no effect); out-of-bounds pointers and impossible lengths trap. A module imports gasm:gl or gasm:gfx, not both.

functions.name: width
functions.doc: Drawable width in pixels (the default framebuffer follows it).

functions.name: height
functions.doc: Drawable height in pixels.

functions.name: frame_shown
functions.doc: 0 during catch-up frames (the runner runs several frames to catch up and shows only the last; the guest may skip drawing); 1 otherwise, headless included.

functions.name: present
functions.doc: Show the default framebuffer now; otherwise the runner presents at the end of the frame.

functions.name: get_error
functions.doc: The oldest GL error flag (GL rules: a call with an error has no effect), or 0.

functions.name: get_string
functions.doc: GL_VENDOR, GL_RENDERER, GL_VERSION, GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION or GL_EXTENSIONS (space-separated): its length, copied if it fits; -1 for an invalid name (GL_INVALID_ENUM).

functions.name: enable_extension
functions.doc: Turn on a WebGL extension listed in GL_EXTENSIONS (1), or 0 if it isn't there.

functions.name: get_integerv
functions.doc: The parameter's values as i32s: how many it has (copied up to count), or -1 for an invalid pname (GL_INVALID_ENUM).

functions.name: get_floatv
functions.doc: As get_integerv, as f32s.

functions.name: get_integer64v
functions.doc: As get_integerv, as i64s.

functions.name: get_integeri_v
functions.doc: Indexed parameters (e.g. GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BINDING), as i32s.

functions.name: get_internalformativ
functions.doc: GL_SAMPLES or GL_NUM_SAMPLE_COUNTS of a renderbuffer format.

functions.name: get_shader_precision_format
functions.doc: Writes 3 i32s: range min, range max, precision.

functions.name: create_buffer
functions.doc: A new buffer name (glGenBuffers).

functions.name: buffer_data
functions.doc: len bytes from data, or zeros if data is 0.

functions.name: get_buffer_sub_data
functions.doc: Read back len bytes (glMapBufferRange for reading).

functions.name: vertex_attrib_pointer
functions.doc: offset into the bound GL_ARRAY_BUFFER (no client-side arrays).

functions.name: get_vertex_attribfv
functions.doc: GL_CURRENT_VERTEX_ATTRIB: 4 f32s.

functions.name: draw_elements
functions.doc: Indices from the bound GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER at offset.

functions.name: draw_buffers
functions.doc: count GLenums.

functions.name: clear_bufferiv
functions.doc: count i32s (4 for GL_COLOR, 1 for GL_STENCIL).

functions.name: tex_image_2d
functions.doc: pixels 0: no data (or, with a bound GL_PIXEL_UNPACK_BUFFER, len is the offset into it); otherwise len must cover the image.

functions.name: generate_mipmap
functions.doc: Runners generate the levels (unlike gasm:gfx).

functions.name: bind_framebuffer
functions.doc: 0: the default framebuffer (the window).

functions.name: read_pixels
functions.doc: len must cover the rectangle; with a bound GL_PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER, dst is the offset into it.

functions.name: shader_source
functions.doc: GLSL ES 3.00 (or 1.00).

functions.name: get_attached_shaders
functions.doc: Shader names (u32), copied up to count; returns how many.

functions.name: get_active_attrib
functions.doc: info: 2 i32s (size, type). Returns the name's length (copied if it fits), or -1.

functions.name: get_uniform_location
functions.doc: -1 if the program has no such uniform.

functions.name: get_uniform_index
functions.doc: glGetUniformIndices for one name (GL_INVALID_INDEX if none).

functions.name: get_active_uniformsiv
functions.doc: count u32 indices in, count i32s out.

functions.name: transform_feedback_varyings
functions.doc: count names, each NUL-terminated, in len bytes.

functions.name: uniform1fv
functions.doc: count vectors (GL semantics).

functions.name: get_queryiv
functions.doc: GL_CURRENT_QUERY: the active query's name.

functions.name: get_query_objectuiv
functions.doc: Results are available from the next frame on, on every runner.

functions.name: fence_sync
functions.doc: A sync name (not a pointer).

functions.name: client_wait_sync
functions.doc: Signaled from the next frame on; a timeout above 0 that isn't met gives GL_TIMEOUT_EXPIRED.

modules.name: gasm:net
modules.doc: Message connections with WebSocket semantics (reliable, ordered, binary), non-blocking. Runners may deny connections (native: --allow-net). A handle that open never returned traps; a closed one reports GASM_NET_CLOSED.

functions.name: open
functions.doc: Open a ws:// or wss:// URL. Handle > 0, or -1 if denied/invalid.

functions.name: state
functions.doc: GASM_NET_CONNECTING / OPEN / CLOSED / ERROR.

functions.name: send
functions.doc: Send one message (len > 0). 0, or -1 if not open.

functions.name: recv
functions.doc: Next message's length (copied only if <= cap, else it stays queued), 0 if none, -1 if closed and drained.

functions.name: close
functions.doc: Close (flushing queued messages); closing again does nothing.

modules.name: gasm:fetch
modules.doc: HTTP requests made by the runner (TLS included), non-blocking: poll each frame. Runners may deny requests (native: --allow-net, optionally a host list; browsers: the page and CORS). A handle that request never returned traps; a closed one reports GASM_FETCH_FAILED.

functions.name: request
functions.doc: Start a request described by JSON {"method":"GET","url":"https://...","headers":{"name":"value"}}, with body_len bytes of body (0: none). Handle > 0, or -1 if denied, invalid or too many are open (16).

functions.name: state
functions.doc: GASM_FETCH_PENDING / HEADERS (status and headers are in) / DONE (the whole body arrived) / FAILED.

functions.name: status
functions.doc: HTTP status of the final response (after redirects), 0 before the headers or after a failure.

functions.name: headers
functions.doc: Response headers as "name: value\n" lines (names lowercase). Length (copied only if <= cap; cap = 0 queries), -1 before GASM_FETCH_HEADERS.

functions.name: read
functions.doc: Copy up to cap bytes of body that have arrived; returns the count, 0 if none are waiting yet, -1 once the body is done and drained or the request failed.

functions.name: close
functions.doc: Cancel if still running and free the handle; closing again does nothing.

modules.name: gasm:storage
modules.doc: Persistent per-game key/value store; the runner chooses the namespace. Keys: 1-128 bytes of [A-Za-z0-9._-]. Values up to 1 MiB, 16 MiB per game. Headless runs start empty.

functions.name: get
functions.doc: Value length, or -1 if missing. Copied only if length <= cap.

functions.name: set
functions.doc: 0, or a GASM_STORAGE_ERR_* code: invalid key, value too large, quota exceeded, I/O error.

functions.name: delete
functions.doc: 0 if deleted, -1 if it did not exist.

functions.name: count
functions.doc: Number of keys in the namespace.

functions.name: key
functions.doc: Key index (0 .. count-1, sorted): its length (copied only if <= cap; cap = 0 queries), or -1 if out of range.

modules.name: gasm:clipboard
modules.doc: Text on the system clipboard. Copying is always allowed; pasting is the player's choice: the text is readable only during the frame that carries the paste key press (Ctrl+V, Cmd+V on macOS), never otherwise. Headless runs have an empty clipboard. Text is UTF-8, up to 1 MiB.

functions.name: set_text
functions.doc: 0: the runner puts it on the clipboard after this frame; -1: refused (over 1 MiB, or no clipboard). Invalid UTF-8 traps.

functions.name: get_text
functions.doc: The pasted text's length in bytes (copied only if <= cap; cap = 0 queries), or -1 outside a paste frame or with nothing to paste.

modules.name: gasm:files
modules.doc: Files for the player, outside the game: save hands the runner a copy to keep where the player finds it (natively Pictures/<game>/ for images, Downloads/<game>/ otherwise, or --save-dir; a download in browsers). The game never learns the path. Headless runs write nothing unless given --save-dir.

functions.name: save
functions.doc: A handle > 0 (the runner saves it after this frame), or -1: refused (saving is off, name empty or over 255 bytes, mime not type/subtype, over 256 MiB, or 16 saves still pending). name is a file name; the runner keeps only its last path component and makes it safe and unique. Invalid UTF-8 traps.

functions.name: state
functions.doc: GASM_FILES_PENDING (0), GASM_FILES_SAVED (1) or GASM_FILES_FAILED (2: cancelled or not written). A handle save never returned traps.

modules.name: wasi_snapshot_preview1
modules.doc: Only proc_exit is part of the gasm ABI proper; runners also provide a libc support subset (see ABI.md).

functions.name: proc_exit
functions.doc: End the game; 0 is a normal exit.

constants.doc: Virtual gamepad buttons (bit positions). Face buttons by position: East=A, South=B, North=X, West=Y.
Bind group layout entry visibility (WebGPU GPUShaderStage bits).

pointer() layout and bits: little-endian fields at the GASM_POINTER_OFF_* byte offsets: f32 x, y (drawable px), fx, fy (frame px), dx, dy (relative motion), wheel_x, wheel_y (lines; y > 0 = down), u32 buttons, pressed, released, flags.

gamepad() layout: little-endian fields at the GASM_GAMEPAD_OFF_* byte offsets: u32 flags, u32 button count, u32 axis count, f32 button values (32), f32 axis values (16). Standard mapping (W3C): buttons 0 south, 1 east, 2 west, 3 north, 4/5 shoulders, 6/7 triggers, 8 select, 9 start, 10/11 stick clicks, 12-15 d-pad up/down/left/right, 16 home; axes 0/1 left stick x/y, 2/3 right stick x/y (y > 0 = down).
key_state() size, and the size of one key_events() record.
Physical keys (W3C KeyboardEvent.code names; layout-independent). The third column is the W3C name.
